battle.name: 蘇赫拉的嚈噠戰役
battle.theater: 小亞細亞東北的蘇赫拉要塞一帶
battle.brief: 公元484年，嚈噠聯盟越過高加索襲擊卡帕多細亞與亞美尼亞邊境，軍事總監阿爾巴齊烏斯率約一萬人據守蘇赫拉要塞前的河谷隘道。匈軍假退誘戰，羅馬按兵不動，待其強攻才以盾列與兩翼騎兵反擊，攻破營壘。卡面科林斯青銅盔的全正面開眼設計，五世紀已退場，其功能由羅馬脊狀鐵盔與匈人鍍金面具接續。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 蘇赫拉的嚈噠戰役爆發於公元484年羅馬帝國東境，交戰的兩方是羅馬帝國與草原部族聯盟，在亞美尼亞邊境的正門前正面碰撞。羅馬一方是東羅馬帝國，皇帝弗拉維烏斯·澤諾出身伊索里亞的安條克王朝，東境最高軍事權力集中在少數幾名magister militum（軍事總監）手上；真正握有邊防的，是受命東進的magister militum per Orientem阿爾巴齊烏斯，他率領由卡帕多細亞、亞美尼亞與色雷斯、依索里亞部隊拼成的野戰軍，另有小亞細亞沿岸的投石與弩砲兵，以及由特拉佩松斯（特拉布宗）海路運來的糧秣。羅馬還必須提防第三者：薩珊波斯的卡瓦德一世正把嚈噠聯盟當作壓在羅馬東境上的槓桿，據普羅科匹烏斯記載，波斯甚至把「弒君者的劍」贈給嚈噠人，明示他們與羅馬為敵。嚈噠一方是游牧部族聯盟，核心是嚈噠人本身（中文史籍稱「白匈奴」），並聯絡魯人、粟特與北高加索諸部，騎兵為骨幹，人數遠多於羅馬野戰軍。戰場在卡帕多細亞與亞美尼亞邊境的山地要塞帶，蘇赫拉是帝國通往高加索的關卡，控住由黑海沿岸翻越山脈通往內陸的商道與牧場。
countriesEn: The Battle of Satala was fought in 484 AD on the eastern frontier of the Roman Empire, where Rome collided with a steppe tribal confederation at the main gate of the Armenian border. On the Roman side stood the Eastern Roman Empire, ruled by Flavius Zeno, an emperor of the Isaurian Antiochene house; on this front the highest military authority rested with a small number of magistri militum. The man who actually held the frontier was the magister militum per Orientem Arbazius, who led a field army pieced together from Cappadocia and Armenia together with Thracian and Isaurian contingents, backed by light stone-throwers and bolt-shooters from the coast of Asia Minor and by grain and stores landing by sea at Trapezus. Rome also had to watch a third party: the Sasanian Empire, whose king Kavad I used the Hephthalite alliance as a lever against Rome, and Procopius records that Persia even handed the Huns the sword of the tyrannicides, marking them out as Rome's declared enemy. The opposing side was a nomadic tribal confederation, its core the Hephthalites themselves, called White Huns in Chinese sources, joined by Rug, Sogdian and North Caucasian groups, with cavalry as the backbone and numbers far exceeding the Roman field army. The fighting took place in the belt of mountain fortresses on the Cappadocian-Armenian border, where Satala was the Empire's gateway to the Caucasus, controlling the road and the pastures that led inland from the Black Sea coast.
people: 皇帝澤諾是這場戰爭的政治背景：公元474年以伊索里亞軍人身份登基後，他倚仗同族將領維持皇位，卻無法控制首都真正的軍事支柱——蠻族出身的軍事總監弗拉維烏斯·阿斯帕爾及其子嗣。公元484年1月，阿爾巴齊烏斯在蘇赫拉取勝還不到一年，澤諾便在尼卡暴動中被推翻，阿斯帕爾父子被殺，流亡中的伊索里亞貴族瓦爾迪米爾即位，成為阿納斯塔修一世。戰場上決定勝負的是magister militum per Orientem阿爾巴齊烏斯（阿爾巴基烏斯），他率約一萬人的野戰軍自北方要塞區南下，在崎嶇的河谷中穩住陣腳，等匈軍主力進入可攻擊的距離才發動反擊；全勝之後，澤諾晉他為patricius，賜金柄寶劍與青銅勝利女神像，讓他在希波德羅馬競技場接受凱旋式，這是羅馬晚期將軍能得到的最高榮譽。嚈噠方面的統帥姓名史無明確記載，現代學者多從普羅科匹烏斯提到的匈王克里馬克或欣吉拉兩人推測，或者認定就是同年率軍打垮薩珊王佩羅茲的那位可汗；而記錄此役全過程的，只有修昔烏斯與普羅科匹烏斯兩位史家的相互補充的記載。
peopleEn: Emperor Zeno is the political background of this war: having come to the throne in 474 as an Isaurian soldier-emperor, he kept his seat by favouring men of his own kin, yet could not control the real military pillar of the capital, the magister militum Flavius Aspar and his sons, who were of Alan and Gothic descent. Less than a year after Arbazius won at Satala, Zeno was overthrown in the Nika riots of January 484; Aspar and his sons were killed, and the exiled Isaurian noble Valdimir took the throne as Anastasius I. The man who decided the battle on the field was the magister militum per Orientem Arbazius (Arbacius), who led about ten thousand men south from the northern fortress belt, held his ground in a broken river valley, and struck only once the Huns had come within reach of his attack. After the victory Zeno raised him to the patriciate, gave him a gold-hilted sword and a bronze Victory, and gave him a triumph in the Hippodrome, the highest honour a late-antique general could receive. The name of the Hunnic commander is nowhere recorded; modern scholars guess at it from Krimak or Khingila, the two Hunnic kings Procopius mentions, or assume that he was the very khan who crushed the Sasanian king Peroz in the same year. The only source for the whole course of the battle is the paired and mutually supporting testimony of Theophanes and Procopius.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔是公元前650年前後希臘hoplites的重裝，觀念是「全正面開眼」：只有一條狹長目孔與鼻梁分隔，看得見正前方，代價是幾乎放棄兩側視野，戴盔者只能靠隊形與聲音活命。公元484年，這種青銅全盔早已退場近千年，羅馬與匈人真正戴的是同一難題的另一種解法：羅馬的脊狀鐵盔（如同多瑙河畔因特西薩出土、以鐵片釘合於皮盔之上的一批五世紀型），以及匈人那一副近乎滿臉的鍍金面具（克里米亞寧法伊翁匈人墓出土、現藏艾爾米塔什博物館的「匈人王金面具」為代表），把「護住面門、留出目孔」的思路推到更極致。真正延續科林斯盔功能的，是護甲體系本身：羅馬步兵披魚鱗甲或鎖子甲，持橢圓盾，騎兵是胸甲化重騎與弓騎的混合；匈人用鐵片、骨片綴成的札甲，握反曲複合弓、直刃鐵劍與長矛，另有五世紀起在草原裝備中開始出現雛形、普及程度仍有爭議的馬鐙。遠程與攻城方面，蘇赫拉要塞自帶弩砲與投石器位，野戰軍攜輕裝投射兵與騎射手，海路糧道則由特拉佩松斯供應。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is the heavy armour of Greek hoplites of about 650 BC, built on the idea of a full face with one narrow eye opening: it sees straight ahead and pays for it by giving up the whole periphery, so that the wearer lives by formation and by the voices of the unit. In 484 AD that bronze full-face helmet had been out of use for nearly a millennium, and what Romans and Huns actually wore was another solution to the same problem: the Roman ridge helmets, such as the iron-plated leather caps excavated at Intercisa on the Danube, and the near-complete gilded face mask of the Huns, of which the golden mask of a Hunnic ruler from the Nymphaeum burial in Crimea, now in the Hermitage, is the most famous example, carried the principle of shielding the face while leaving the eyes open to its extreme. What actually carried on the function of the Corinthian helmet was the armour system as a whole: Roman infantry in scale or mail with oval shields, and a cavalry mix of armoured heavies and mounted archers; the Huns in lamellar of iron, horn and bone plates, with recurved composite bows, straight iron swords and long lances, plus the earliest forms of stirrup that begin to appear in steppe equipment of the fifth century, their spread still much debated. On the missile and siege side the fortress of Satala carried bolt and stone throwers of its own, the field army brought light artillery and javelin-armed foot, and the sea route to Trapezus kept the army supplied.
tactics: 蘇赫拉前線的地形，逼出一場典型的「以靜制動」之戰。羅馬軍沿阿爾塔雷提（Arsarethi）一線的關口與河谷佈防，居高佔據卡帕多細亞山脈的隘道，刻意不把陣地讓到開闊平原；普羅科匹烏斯記載，嚈噠人多次用假退與繞擊想引羅馬騎兵離陣，羅馬軍按命令不追，把騎兵收在陣腳內部，用密集的步兵盾牆與投射武器覆蓋正面。糧秣是羅馬的第三條線：從特拉佩松斯經海路與陸路運到軍營，拖住匈軍的時間。真正致命的反擊發生在匈軍主動進攻之時，羅馬軍在狹窄河谷內列陣，兩翼騎兵掩護正面，步兵隨即以盾列向前推移，把游牧騎兵擠壓在無處回旋的坡地上；匈軍陣形一散，羅馬軍隨即攻入其營壘，奪取帳幕、牲口與輜重。整場戰鬥的關鍵是羅馬軍的紀律：嚴守陣線、等待時機、不追擊潰兵，這正是全盔時代「靠隊形活」的老規矩在鐵甲時代的翻版。
tacticsEn: The shape of the Satala front produced a classic battle of waiting and letting the enemy break himself. The Roman army took up position along the defiles and valleys around Arsarethi, holding the heights of the Cappadocian range and deliberately refusing to move down into the open plain. Procopius describes the Huns trying again and again to draw the Roman cavalry out with feigned retreats and flanking attacks; the Romans obeyed orders and did not pursue, keeping the horse inside the line and covering the front with a dense wall of shields and missile fire. Logistics was the Roman third front: stores came by sea and by land from Trapezus to the camp, and the drag on the Huns' own supplies was part of the plan. The decisive counterstroke came when the Huns attacked of their own accord. The Romans drew up in the narrow valley, cavalry on the two flanks checking the onset, and the infantry advanced behind the shield wall, squeezing the mounted nomads onto ground where they could not turn. Once the Hunnic order dissolved, the Romans stormed the camp and took tents, livestock and baggage. Discipline was the hinge of the whole action: hold the line, wait for the moment, do not chase the routed. That is the old rule of the full-helmet age, you live by formation, restated in the age of iron.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但史家的記載互相對得上：羅馬野戰軍約一萬人（修昔烏斯如此記載），匈軍人數被形容為遠多於此，具體數目不傳；蘇赫拉要塞在四世紀的守軍編制為八千人（阿米亞努斯·馬爾利利努斯語），可見羅馬在這條防線上並非毫無準備。地域尺度上，蘇赫拉要塞在今土耳其特拉布宗省於爾居布阿茲一帶，位於喬魯河上游河谷，離黑海岸線約六十公里，控住由海岸翻越本提克山脈通往卡帕多細亞的唯一軍用大道；戰役的具體月份史無明載，一般繫於公元484年，而同年年底嚈噠人再向羅馬索求約三千鎊黃金與一千鎊白銀的貢賦，數目雖為史家轉述，仍可看出雙方對邊境代價的估算差異。同一年的另一場戰役裏，嚈噠聯軍在阿姆河一役擊敗並俘虜薩珊王佩羅茲，說明這支部聯盟在484年仍有足以傾覆一個王朝的實力。
dataEn: Few numbers survive that can be checked, though the historians corroborate one another. The Roman field army numbered about ten thousand men, as Theophanes writes; the Hunnic host is described as much larger, with no exact figure given. The garrison of Satala in the fourth century was eight thousand men, in the words of Ammianus Marcellinus, which shows that Rome had not left this line unprepared. In terms of geography, the fortress of Satala lay in the upper valley of the Çoruh, at today's Gürcüboğaz in Trabzon Province, roughly sixty kilometres from the Black Sea shore, and it controlled the single military road that climbed out of the coast and over the Pontic range into Cappadocia. The exact month of the battle is nowhere recorded, and it is generally placed in 484; by the end of that same year the Huns demanded from Rome a tribute of about three thousand pounds of gold and a thousand pounds of silver, a figure transmitted by later chroniclers that still shows how differently the two sides priced the cost of the frontier. In a different battle of the same year, at the Oxus, the Hephthalite coalition destroyed and captured the Sasanian king Peroz, which proves that this confederation still possessed in 484 the strength to overturn a dynasty.
cause: 起因有三層。最遠的一層是西羅馬帝國在476年崩潰，草原與中亞的部族聯盟趁勢西推，嚈噠人沿裏海東岸與高加索通道進入南高加索與羅馬亞美尼亞。第二層是薩珊波斯的算計：卡瓦德一世把嚈噠聯盟當作壓在羅馬東境上的石頭，484年波斯與羅馬仍隔著亞美尼亞與美索不達米亞對峙，嚈噠人實際上在替波斯削弱羅馬的邊防，這也是普羅科匹烏斯把「弒君者的劍」說法傳給嚈噠人的背景。最直接的一層是484年的越境：嚈噠人突破高加索山口，襲擊卡帕多細亞與亞美尼亞的邊地村落與牧場，直抵羅馬的關卡群，蘇赫拉是其中最重要的一座，羅馬不能容忍它在匈軍的衝撞下淪陷，因為一旦失守，東部的道路與稅源就一起暴露。還有一層是澤諾個人的處境：他需要一場乾淨的勝利來壓住首都的軍人集團，於是把東境最能打的將領與僅有的野戰兵力押在蘇赫拉。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The furthest back is the collapse of the Western Roman Empire in 476, which let the steppe and Central Asian tribal confederations push west; the Hephthalites moved along the eastern shore of the Caspian and through the Caucasian passes into Transcaucasia and Roman Armenia. The middle layer is Sasanian calculation: king Kavad I used the Hephthalite alliance as a stone on Rome's eastern frontier, and in 484 Persia and Rome still faced each other across Armenia and Mesopotamia, with the Huns effectively doing Persia's work of weakening the Roman border, which is the background to the story of the sword of the tyrannicides that Procopius has Persia passing to them. The most immediate layer is the incursion of 484 itself: the Hephthalites broke through the Caucasian passes and raided the villages and pastures of the frontier zone in Cappadocia and Armenia, driving straight at the chain of Roman forts, of which Satala was the most important. Rome could not allow it to be battered down, because if it fell the roads and the tax revenue of the east would lie open. One more layer is Zeno's own position: he needed a clean victory to hold down the military group that really ruled the capital, so he committed to Satala the best general he had and the only field army he could spare.
impact: 這場勝仗在帝國境內引起的震動，遠大於它在邊境上換來的幾個月安寧。澤諾把蘇赫拉之役寫成對「匈人暴政」的正義鎮壓，讓阿爾巴齊烏斯在首都接受凱旋，卻沒有改變東境防守的真實結構：嚈噠聯軍在484年擊潰薩珊王佩羅茲之後，行動力完全轉向西方，羅馬的亞美尼亞與卡帕多細亞在此後數十年反覆被掃掠，薩法爾肯一世時期的亞美尼亞首府被焚，馬爾丁與阿爾塔雷提要塞相繼失守，最終在六世紀上半葉逼出查士丁尼的邊防改革與美索不達米亞防線的短期放棄。更深一層的政治影響在首都：阿爾巴齊烏斯的捷報未能挽救澤諾，484年1月的尼卡暴動中阿斯帕爾父子被殺，澤諾流亡並由阿納斯塔修一世接位，而阿納斯塔修正是靠向嚈噠人繳納貢賦才換得邊境安寧。蘇赫拉的凱旋因此是帝國政治的一次反諷：它證明了邊軍能贏，卻證明不了皇帝坐得穩。
impactEn: The earthquake this victory caused inside the Empire was far larger than the few months of quiet it bought on the frontier. Zeno dressed the battle up as the righteous punishment of a Hunnish tyranny and let Arbazius take a triumph in the capital, yet nothing in the real structure of the eastern defence changed. Freed by the defeat of Peroz in 484, the Hephthalite coalition turned its whole strength westward, and Roman Armenia and Cappadocia were raided again and again in the following decades: the Armenian capital under Saharaken I was burned, the strongholds of Mardin and Artarethi fell one after another, and in the first half of the sixth century the pressure finally forced Justinian's frontier reforms and the temporary abandonment of the Mesopotamian limes. The deeper political effect was felt in the capital: Arbazius' good news saved no one. In the Nika riots of January 484 Aspar and his sons were killed, Zeno fled and Anastasius I succeeded him, and Anastasius bought frontier peace by paying the Hephthalites a tribute. Satala is therefore a historical irony for the Empire: it proved that the field army could win, while proving that the emperor could not hold his own throne.
result: 結果是羅馬方在戰術上贏得乾淨。嚈噠軍在河谷中被突破，營壘被攻破，帳幕、牲群與輜重盡為羅馬軍所得，殘部向北退回高加索與草原深處；阿爾巴齊烏斯率軍返回，澤諾晉他為patricius，賜金柄寶劍並在希波德羅馬競技場立青銅勝利女神像，羅馬的宣傳機器把這場戰役寫成邊防的證明。但軍事上，羅馬守住了蘇赫拉，卻沒有把嚈噠人趕出高加索以南的秋季牧場；匈軍同年仍向羅馬索取約三千鎊黃金與一千鎊白銀的貢賦，澤諾拒絕，此事隨著他倒台而告吹，繼位的阿納斯塔修一世改以讓步換取停戰，甚至把匈使押入競技場當眾羞辱。戰役的直接結果因此是清楚的——羅馬守住一座要塞，嚈噠保住整片草原；而戰役的真正結算，要到六世紀才由查士丁尼時代的人去做。
resultEn: The result was a clean Roman tactical victory. The Huns were broken in the valley, their camp was stormed, and tents, herds and baggage all fell to the Romans; the survivors withdrew north towards the Caucasus and the deep steppe. Arbazius led his army home, and Zeno made him a patrician, gave him a gold-hilted sword, and set up a bronze Victory and a triumph in the Hippodrome, while the Roman publicity machine wrote the battle up as proof of what the frontier was worth. Militarily, though, Rome kept Satala without pushing the Hephthalites out of the autumn pastures south of the Caucasus. In the same year the Huns still demanded roughly three thousand pounds of gold and a thousand pounds of silver from Rome; Zeno refused, and the question died with him, while his successor Anastasius I exchanged concessions for a truce and even had the Hunnic envoys dragged into the arena in public humiliation. The direct outcome is therefore clear: Rome saved a fortress and the Huns kept the whole grassland. The true settlement of Satala was not made until the Byzantines of Justinian's day.
